Position and private ranges · JSON

Both players' ranges are public assumptions. Only the selected player's actual private state is queried. Joint cases can represent correlated beliefs.

Model and accuracy

Numerical cards cost 1–6 and have equal power. Twelve-card decks, six turns, three neutral locations, four slots per player per location, three opening cards plus one draw per turn, seven-card hand limit, simultaneous complete-turn commitments, passing allowed. No abilities, special locations, snaps or retreats.

Outcome EV = P(win) − P(loss). A small measured deviation bound is required before confident grading. Sampled early-game results remain provisional when an exhaustive bound cannot be computed. Frequencies belong to one approximate strategy; frequency alone does not grade an individual move.

The midgame preset ranges use explicitly uniform historical legal play. They are conditional continuation games, not an assertion that the opponent previously played equilibrium. The engine also supports Bayesian conditioning on an averaged full-game reference policy.
